method: On each fixed historical fold, compare 1,000-world regulation-minute targets conditional on the actual participant sets. The four variants use matching per-game/team normal draws and each fold’s own pre-validation ramp/spread fit; tiers come from the causal-base pregame profiles.
limitations: Target distributions are not the complete possession-engine output. Actual participants are supplied after the game, so these results do not score pre-game availability or unconditional minutes; all candidate differences remain exploratory.
